title: Your catalog.
description: Find familiar items, keep your own prices, and make room for what your neighbourhood needs.
draftNotice: Prototype catalog · Generated names need language review. Catalog prices and pack MRPs are illustrative, not live market prices. Your saved prices take priority.
voiceNote: Live voice search is planned. Type a name or alias for now.
emptyBody: Try another search or category, or show hidden items.
unavailableBody: Check your connection and try again. A previously loaded catalog can be searched from this browser’s cache while the workspace stays open.
cached: Cached catalog · Search is available. Changes need a connection.
storageUnavailable: This browser could not save a catalog cache. Online search still works.
favouritesHint: Pick a favourite to view its details.
customBody: Custom items stay in your store. You can nominate one for review later; it will never be published automatically.
name: Item name
editBody: Saved prices apply only to your store. Quantity-unit preferences do not change the price basis.
created: Custom item added to your catalog.
deleteBody: It will disappear from your catalog. Existing sale records will remain independent of this item.
nominateNote: Nomination submits the item name, unit and type for review. It does not publish it.
nominated: Submitted for review. This item is still private to your store.
budgetNote: Exact affordable quantity and the rounded shop suggestion are shown separately. No bill is created here.
implausible: That quantity is above this item’s usual example limit. Please check it.
